description: List every stored Bot Appétit scan of one exact page, newest first, with the score at the time and how it moved since the scan before. Costs nothing and does not scan. Use it to show whether a page has improved. Blocked and failed scans are listed without a score.

url.description: The exact page, such as https://example.com/pricing. `/a` and `/a/` are different pages.

name: page_history
title: Get a page’s history
